status: Closed — Fixed; sealed candidate commit analysis lane verified in current runner
finding: Pre-commit cross-file consistency and git record-commit scope analysis enumerate the live worktree or entire staged index instead of the sealed candidate being committed. Unrelated half-staged symbols from another lane can therefore block a task-scoped commit and be misclassified as classification=current-task even though the candidate contains none of those bytes.
expectedBehavior: Every validator and scope guard participating in a governed commit must analyze the same sealed candidate tree and attribution envelope. Live worktree/index state outside that candidate may be preserved and reported as foreign context, but cannot become current-task content or block an unrelated commit unless a proven dependency edge intersects the candidate.
evidenceOrRepro: Historical incident: foreign half-staged entries were preserved byte-identically by the task-scoped facade but hook and record analysis still enumerated the live surface. Current source repair: `resolvePreCommitResidueCandidates()` selects `git diff --cached --name-only` when the sealed candidate index is active; ticket-scoped selection limits admission to the exact candidate and retains the full staged surface only when no in-scope candidate exists. `node --strip-types tests/cli/commit-admission-ticket-scoped-selection.test.ts` passes both scoped admission and byte-identical foreign-stage preservation; `node --strip-types packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance/implementation/broker-hook-bypass-preflight.test.ts` passes candidate-only broker admission and rejects a foreign path when it is actually named in the candidate.
followUp: Source repair is verified. Retain the sealed candidate selection and candidate-only hook admission regressions; a dependency proven inside a candidate must remain fail-closed. Frozen publication and formal governance closeout are separate from this backlog status.
